rappel_detail.anchor: fixed anchor near the crux; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The upper anchor on the East Peak's east ridge, near the 5.4 crux step.
rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels of about 30 m, on a rope plus a tagline.

rappel_detail.anchor: fixed anchor; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The next anchor down the east ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: Second rappel of about 30 m, back toward East Triad Col. From the col, rope up to re-cross the Triad Glacier.
hazards: Open crevasses on the Triad Glacier below, especially late in the season.

set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels of about 30 m with a rope and a tagline are the usual descent; some parties downclimb this section instead.
